falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 2 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern featured VIX peaking at 28 and rapidly mean-reverting; sustained VIX above 35 indicates a systemic stress event unlike that orderly bottom, invalidating the pattern match and suggesting a deeper/more prolonged correction than the 2024 August structure

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury yield curve inverts by more than -50bps (10Y yield minus 2Y yield < -0.50%)
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The 2024 August bottom occurred with a modestly positive or flat curve; severe inversion signals recession pricing inconsistent with a V-bottom recovery pattern, indicating the macro regime has shifted to contraction rather than soft-landing consolidation

falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below its August 2024 swing low (4,119.58) on a weekly basis
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern held above prior structural support; breaking that level confirms this is not a fractal repeat but a lower-low sequence, invalidating the 76% pattern match and converting the signal from HOLD to active bearish continuation
